verdict.rationale: Evidence shows CLI headless-style options (auto-approve all actions, non-interactive task execution) plus GitHub workflow automations (failed-workflow fixes, security alert remediation, PR review triggers via label events) that imply CI/CD-style headless invocation, and API support for automation/scripting. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated CI/CD flag, exit-code semantics, or a documented shell-script/pipeline invocation pattern. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline integration docs, headless/non-interactive mode flag documentation, and independent confirmation of scripted/automated invocation in build pipelines.
